content: Phoenix security headers: framework provides plug-level hooks (Plug.SSL for force_ssl+HSTS, custom put_secure_browser_headers in the :browser pipeline) rather than a single built-in 'SecurityHeaders' module; community libraries like anotherhale/secure_headers exist to centralize CSP/X-Frame-Options/X-Content-Type-Options/HSTS but are optional - a hand-written plug is common and sufficient at small scale. Baseline set: Content-Security-Policy (start with default-src 'self', add specific origins e.g. Maps iframe as already done for CSP frame-src), Strict-Transport-Security (via Plug.SSL's hsts: true), X-Frame-Options: DENY/SAMEORIGIN, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. Session cookie should set secure: true, http_only: true, same_site: "Lax" (Strict breaks some cross-site nav/share flows).
